  "description": "Ascentech Services Limited is a human resources solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build stronger teams and manage people functions more effectively. Established in Nigeria in 2013, we have supported organizations for years with high-quality, practical HR services designed to meet real business needs; adapting to evolving workforce demands and enabling long-term growth. With a strong presence in Lagos and Ibadan, and an expanding footprint through Ascentforce in India, we deliver a broader, more connected approach to recruitment, outsourcing, training, and ongoing HR support.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Fleet Head of Department (Fleet HOD)

Job Location: Kogi&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and strategic Fleet Head of Department to lead and manage our entire fleet operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing vehicle acquisition, maintenance, driver management, compliance, cost control, and operational efficiency across the organization. This is a senior leadership role requiring a hands-on professional with a proven track record of optimizing fleet performance, reducing costs, and ensuring safety and regulatory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
Fleet Strategy &amp; Operations Management:


	Develop and implement fleet strategies, policies, and procedures to optimize vehicle utilization, reliability, and efficiency.
	Oversee daily fleet operations, including vehicle deployment, routing, scheduling, and logistics coordination.
	Ensure timely delivery of goods, services, or personnel in line with organizational objectives.


Vehicle Maintenance &amp; Asset Management:


	Establish and manage preventive and corrective maintenance programs to minimize vehicle downtime and extend asset lifespan.
	Oversee vehicle inspections, servicing, repairs, and warranty management.
	Maintain accurate records of vehicle history, mileage, fuel consumption, and maintenance costs.


Driver &amp; Staff Management:


	Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate drivers, mechanics, and fleet support staff.
	Implement driver performance monitoring systems, including telematics and GPS tracking.
	Promote safe driving practices and conduct regular driver training and refresher courses.


Compliance &amp; Regulatory Adherence:


	Ensure all fleet vehicles are roadworthy, properly insured, and fully documented (vehicle registration, licenses, permits, etc.).
	Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, including FRSC, NTSB, DOT, and local traffic laws.
	Manage accident reporting, investigation, and claims processes.


Budgeting &amp; Cost Control:


	Prepare and manage the fleet budget, including fuel, maintenance, insurance, and procurement costs.
	Implement cost-saving initiatives, such as fuel efficiency programs, route optimization, and vendor negotiations.
	Monitor and report on fleet financial performance, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.


Procurement &amp; Disposal:


	Manage the acquisition, leasing, or disposal of vehicles, ensuring cost-effectiveness and alignment with operational needs.
	Negotiate with vendors, suppliers, and OEMs for competitive pricing on vehicles, parts, and services.
	Ensure timely replacement of ageing or high-maintenance vehicles.


Technology &amp; Data Management:


	Oversee the implementation and management of fleet management software, GPS tracking, and telematics systems.
	Leverage data analytics to monitor driver behavior, fuel consumption, maintenance trends, and overall fleet performance.
	Prepare and present detailed fleet performance reports to senior management and stakeholders.


Health, Safety &amp; Environment (HSE):


	Enforce strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards across all fleet operations.
	Conduct risk assessments and implement safety protocols to reduce accidents and liabilities.
	Ensure all vehicles meet environmental emissions standards.


Candidate Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in fleet management, logistics, or transport operations, with at least 4 years in a senior management or leadership capacity.
	Proven track record of managing large and diverse vehicle fleets (e.g., trucks, buses, heavy equipment, or light vehicles).
	Master&#39;s degree (MBA or MSc in relevant field) is an added advantage.
	Professional certifications such as CILT (Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport), CPFP (Certified Professional Fleet Manager), or equivalent are highly desirable.
	Strong knowledge of fleet management software, GPS tracking systems, and telematics.
	Proficiency in MS Office Suite, particularly Excel for data analysis and reporting.
	Understanding of vehicle mechanics, maintenance practices, and lifecycle cost analysis.
	Knowledge of Nigerian regulatory frameworks (FRSC, NTSB, etc.).
	Strong leadership, team management, and people development skills.
	Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
	Outstanding communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
	Valid driver&#39;s license.
	Willingness to travel as required.
	Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the specified location.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV and relevant certifications to: cv@ascentech.com.ng using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

title: Job openings at Royal Resource Digital Services
content:
Royal Resource Digital Services is a creative agency helping businesses grow through modern web design, branding, and digital marketing.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Experienced Customer Support Executive - Real Estate 

Job Location: Lekki-Ajah, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time
Company: Leading Real Estate Company

Role Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a proactive and client-focused Real Estate Customer Support Executive to join our team.
	The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for clients, ensuring excellent service and smooth communication throughout the property buying journey.


Key Responsibilities


	Handle inbound/outbound client calls, emails, and WhatsApp inquiries.
	Provide information on available properties, site visits, and documentation.
	Maintain accurate client database and follow-ups.
	Liaise between clients, sales, and operations teams.
	Ensure high level of customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements


	OND/HND/B.Sc in any related field.
	Must have 1-2 years of experience in Real Estate OR Banking.
	Experience in both Real Estate and Banking/Financial Marketing is an added advantage.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Proficient in MS Office and CRM tools.
	Must be resident in or around Lekki-Ajah.


Salary
N150,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 18th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Application to: [email protected] using the Job Position and location as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Relationship Manager / HR Assistant 

ComparingCRM Platforms

Job Location: Kaduna 

Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Primary Focus: Client + Realtor relationship management
	Secondary Focus: HR support and employee engagement


Requirements


	Experience: 1–3 years of experience
	Must-Have: Excellent communication, interpersonal, follow-up, coordination, and conflict-resolution skills
	Preferred: Previous experience in real estate, sales, customer relationship management, or HR
	Personality: Proactive, professional, people-oriented, organized, diplomatic, and confident
	Important: Candidate must be comfortable dealing with clients, realtors, sales executives, employees, and management.


Application Closing Date: 3rd September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Application Documents


	Updated CV
	Location
	 Position Applied For
	Number of years experience
	1 minute video introducing yourself and why you are the best fit for this role


Video requirements:


	Maximum 1 minute long
	Not larger than 20MB
	Send direct video file. No links


Note


	Only candidates who meet the requirements will be contacted.
	Incomplete applications will not be accepted.


 

 

3.) Creative Content Strategist (Real Estate) 

Job Location: Kaduna
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	Are you a creative thinker who can turn ideas into engaging content that attracts attention and drives results?
	We are looking for a talented and innovative **Creative Content Strategist** to lead content creation and digital storytelling for a growing real estate company in Kaduna.
	The ideal candidate understands modern content trends, is comfortable using AI tools, can create compelling videos and graphics, and knows how to build an engaging online presence that generates leads and brand awareness.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute content strategies across social media platforms
	Create engaging short-form video content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube
	Design high-quality graphics and marketing materials
	Write compelling captions, scripts, and marketing copy
	Plan and manage content calendars
	Cover property inspections, client testimonials, and company events
	Create content that generates engagement, inquiries, and sales leads
	Monitor content performance and recommend improvements
	Stay updated on social media trends, AI tools, and content marketing innovations
	Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to support business objectives


Requirements


	Proven experience in content creation, social media management, or digital marketing
	Strong graphic design skills
	Strong video creation and editing skills
	Knowledge of Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
	Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools
	Excellent storytelling and creative thinking abilities
	Strong written and verbal communication skills
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
	Good understanding of social media algorithms and content trends


Preferred Skills:


	Experience creating content for real estate, hospitality, lifestyle, or related industries
	Photography and videography skills
	Experience with Meta Ads and content-driven lead generation
	Knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Veo, Gemini, or similar platforms


What We're Looking For


	Creative and innovative mindset
	Strong visual storytelling ability
	AI-savvy and future-focused
	Detail-oriented and organized
	Results-driven and proactive
	Passionate about creating content that performs
	Candidates residing in Kaduna will be given preference.


Benefits


	Competitive salary (Salary: N80,000 - N100,000 per month.)
	Opportunity to work in a fast-growing real estate company
	Exposure to modern marketing and AI tools
	Career growth and development opportunities
	Creative freedom to execute ideas.


Application Closing Date: 31st August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV, Portfolio or links to previous work (if available), a brief cover note explaining why they are a good fit to: [email protected] using "Creative Content Strategist – Kaduna" as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For more Information, WhatsApp on 09046575527
	Candidates residing in Kaduna will be given preference.

  "title": "Marketing Operations Coordinator",
  "description": "VisionSpring is creating access to affordable eyewear, everywhere. Clear vision creates opportunities for increased learning, work, safety, civic participation, and quality of life. As a social enterprise, social change motivates us first. Our focus on sales and revenue targets serves and advances our mission objective&mdash;to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low-income consumers by correcting refractive error and presbyopia with eyeglasses. We are working to transform the systemic dysfunction of an optical market that has failed to deliver eyeglasses&mdash;a 700-year-old technology&mdash;to 2.7 billion consumers in need of vision correction, most of whom live on less than $4 a day.

We serve low-income consumers, not as beneficiaries but as customers. Our customers expect a high-quality and affordable product, and they will spend limited discretionary income for the immediate and tangible benefits of vision correction. By selling eyeglasses, we awaken new demand and seed a viable market. By selling new eyeglasses we are able to serve four times as many people per dollar input than the alternative of donating recycled ones. To efficiently scale, we must deliver each new unit at a lower cost. We run our business on both sales metrics and social impact measures. We use a range of organizational forms and practices to get the job done. We believe in scaling our impact, not our organization. We are a lean team of doers.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Marketing Operations Coordinator

Job Location: Nigeria
Job ype: Contract-based part-time position

Job Description&nbsp;


	VisionSpring is seeking a Marketing Operations Coordinator to support in executing marketing programs across eight markets in Asia and sub-Saharan Africa.
	This role provides hands-on operational and content support across B2B, B2C, and B2P marketing activities, helping the global marketing team deliver high-quality campaigns, assets, and events efficiently and on time.
